input.name: effect-docs
input.request: Open the Effect documentation for the person: open https://effect.website/docs in the chat so the page shows right there for them to read.

drafts.name: effect-docs
drafts.source:
// Drafted by Smithers from a prompt. In this form it runs on your device; other code needs a sandbox.
import { AgentAction } from "@smthrs/agent"
import { Flow } from "@smthrs/flow"
import { Schema } from "effect"

/** What the agent does each time the flow runs. */
const instructions = [
  "Open the Effect documentation page for the person, right in the chat.",
  "",
  "1. Call app/web/open exactly once, with:",
  "   - url: \"https://effect.website/docs\" — exactly this URL, no anchors, query strings, or other Effect site.",
  "   - mode: the default \"embed\", so the page shows inside the chat with its origin above it.",
  "   Do not call app/navigate (it only opens this app's own paths), and do not call any other flow. Opening a web page needs no clone, no read, no branch, and no question to the person.",
  "",
  "2. Respond from the answer, and be accurate about what the person actually sees:",
  "   - If the call did not succeed, say the documentation page could not be opened, quote the error's message or hint, and stop.",
  "   - If shown is \"page\", tell the person the Effect documentation is now shown inline in the chat for them to scroll and read.",
  "   - If shown is \"card\" (framing \"refused\" or \"unknown\"), the site refused to be embedded or embedding could not be checked. Tell the person you added a card with an \"Open in new tab\" button that opens the Effect docs in a new browser tab. Never say the page is shown in the chat in this case.",
  "",
  "3. Then stop. Your confirmation is at most a short sentence. Do not summarize the docs, ask follow-up questions, or take any other action.",
].join("\n")

/** The flow's one step: the agent follows the instructions with the run's input. */
const Agent = AgentAction.make("effect-docs/agent", {
  payload: { input: Schema.String },
  output: Schema.String,
  seat: "agent",
  prompt: ({ input }) => (input === "" ? instructions : `${instructions}\n\nInput: ${input}`),
})

export default Flow.make("effect-docs", {
  description: "Opens the Effect documentation in the person's chat: calls app/web/open on https://effect.website/docs in embed mode so the page appears inline for them to read, and honestly reports when the site refuses embedding.",
  capabilities: [],
  flows: ["app/web/open"],
  payload: { input: Schema.String },
  success: Schema.String,
  error: Agent.errorSchema,
  body: ({ input }) => Agent.call({ input }),
})
